official_operations.summary: Current INSPIRE files are published as the 5 July 2026 release.
The dataset is updated on the first Sunday of each month.
Each monthly release represents data from the preceding month.
Files are partitioned by local authority area.
The product covers registered freehold property and is a subset of Index Polygons.
Polygons show position and indicative extent, not legal title extent.
Every polygon carries a unique Land Registry-INSPIRE identifier.
The authority files are supplied as GML for GIS processing.
Native polygon capture is against British National Grid / EPSG:27700.
Reprojection to WGS84 mapping can shift some features by up to 15 metres.
The composite DTM provides approximately 99% England coverage at 1 metre resolution.
Surface objects are removed to produce terrain-only elevation.
Bulk data is supplied as GeoTIFF in 5 km OS National Grid tiles.
The coordinate reference system is EPSG:27700.
Stated LIDAR vertical accuracy is ±15 cm RMSE.
The yearless DTM WCS endpoint is intended to remain persistent.
WCS is the supported route for raw elevation pixel retrieval.
The public DTM service advertises WCS 2.0.1 capabilities.
The currently advertised OS Terrain 50 version date is July 2026.
Terrain 50 is free OpenData for commercial, educational and personal use.
OpenData operations of the Downloads API do not require an API key.
The official area filter explicitly supports National Grid area TQ.
Grid supply uses 10 km tiles with regular 50 m post spacing.
ASCII/GML tiled national supply is downloadable online without registration and is refreshed annually in July.

candidate_template.summary: Exact target row is preserved; nearest-row fallback remains forbidden.
Row remains bound to the exact preserved HMLR INSPIRE identifier.
Preserved height_difference_m is not promoted as a fresh measurement.
Canonical point remains inside the unique native HMLR polygon.
Existing official evidence records one unique native polygon match.
Existing polygon area is finite and positive.
Existing polygon feature remains SHA-256 bound.
Fresh local-authority HMLR ZIP route is locked.
EA request is pinned to the exact DTM 1m CoverageId.
EA WCS subset is locked to exact EPSG:27700 polygon bounds.
Exact fail-closed WCS GetCoverage request is prepared.
OS Downloads API discovery is restricted to official area TQ.
Candidate maps deterministically to its 10 km Terrain 50 tile.
Polygon bbox is contained by expected tile bounds.
Promotion requires EA DTM1m max-minus-min over valid pixel centres within 0.001 m.

integrity_template.summary: Increment uses the existing continuation key without a second logical job.
Existing canonical task id is reused; no duplicate task is created.
Existing attempt 020 remains the only attempt in scope.
Latest ownership state is unclaimed with lease_version 0.
Latest heartbeat remains absent and stale after 900 seconds.
No second runner or daemon is created from the support environment.
The existing child branch is reused.
The existing draft PR 1272 is reused.
No business measurement row is written.
No fresh official numeric row is promoted without response bytes.
No fresh HMLR geometry is promoted without current GML bytes.
No fresh Terrain 50 sample is promoted without ZIP/ASC/PRJ bytes.
No port 8012 acceptance is claimed without loopback HTTP/DOM receipts.
Fresh HMLR response must have successful status, non-zero bytes and ZIP signature.
Outer HMLR ZIP and extracted GML must both receive SHA-256 hashes.
Extracted GML must contain exactly one matching INSPIRE ID for each target.
Extracted GML must declare EPSG:27700 before geometry acceptance.
WCS response must have successful status and a GeoTIFF-compatible content type.
Each WCS GeoTIFF must be hashed before raster sampling.
Raster CRS must resolve to EPSG:27700.
NoData pixels must be excluded from polygon min/max.
Only valid pixel centres inside exact HMLR geometry may enter the metric.
height_difference_m is max_m_odn minus min_m_odn, not median elevation.
Fresh result must agree with bound result within 0.001 m before promotion.
Terrain 50 link discovery uses the official Downloads API, not a guessed static path.
Downloads API response must be filtered to area TQ.
Requested product format must be ASCII Grid and GML (Grid).
Terrain 50 outer response archive must be hashed.
Required TQ39, TQ59 and TQ27 tiles must be discovered from archive metadata.
ASC header must confirm 200 columns, 200 rows and 50 m spacing.
ASC origin must match the expected 10 km tile bounds.
PRJ or metadata must bind horizontal CRS to British National Grid.
Terrain 50 values remain secondary screening and cannot replace EA parcel measurement.
Every Increment 221 child file is size- and SHA-256-bound in one manifest.
Web view must display every operation from 4485 through 4596 exactly once.
The child branch is not force-reset, rebased or merged by this support page while the canonical base moves.

blockers.summary: Windows F-host guarded recovery, git snapshot, daemon restart and final sampling receipts remain absent.
Fresh HMLR GML, EA WCS GeoTIFF and OS Terrain 50 target archive bytes are not observed and hashed.
Loopback port 8012 exact-row HTTP/DOM acceptance has not run.
Child branch is 831 commits behind the moving canonical base at the pre-write comparison and requires the single serial publisher.
